This favourable development was primarily driven by benign loss experience on Open Market Property and Flood accounts and favourable prior year claims experience on Construction, Specialty and Property classes across previous accident years. While the syndicate was impacted by current year natural catastrophe events like Winter Storm Uri and Hurricane Ida, and prior year losses from COVID-19, the overall reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years resulted in a surplus.
